title: Identification of Nonlinear Acyclic Networks in Continuous Time from Nonzero Initial Conditions and Full Excitations
summary: This paper addresses the identifiability and identification of nonlinear acyclic networks in continuous time when the dynamics are located on the edges and all the nodes are excited. First, we establish necessary and sufficient conditions for network identifiability. We show that it is necessary and sufficient to measure all the sinks to identify any tree in continuous time when the functions associated with the dynamics are analytic and satisfy $f(0)=0$, which is analogous to the discrete-time case.
